messages:
Samir A: Heads-up 1 InvoiceIQ sent their pilot proposal + sample CSV. key bits: 750k committed tokens/mo, $14 / 1M committed, $33 overage, EUR billing preferred (they invoice from EU entity), 200 onboarding fee, want net-45. quote: https://vendor-quotes.internal/invoiceiq/21399
Dana (Fin): EUR billing adds complexity. we need to know whether they will invoice USD to our US entity or only EUR. also need W-9 / EU VAT invoice and tax handling. finance won't approve net-45 without CFO sign-off.
Samir A: pasted sample invoice and CSV header they provided:
```
INV-21399,2026-08-01,2026-08-31,committed_tokens,750000,14,10.50
INV-21399,2026-08-01,2026-08-31,overage_tokens,50000,33,1.65
INV-21399,2026-08-01,2026-08-31,onboarding_fee,1,1200,1200.00
```
CSV schema: hashed_request_id,timestamp,token_count,client_id
They claim token_count uses same BPE tokenizer but split policy differs for multi-turn; will provide mapping doc.
Marco (Eng): need per-request exports with our hashed_request_id and raw prompt/response lengths to confirm token math. also want sample of 3 days of data to run automatic diff. any timezone issues if they bill in CET?
Ivy C: commercial ask: propose 4-month pilot (not 12), onboarding waived, PO/net-30 accepted, and a 15% pilot discount for committed volume. ask them to bill USD from their US subsidiary or add currency protection clause.
procure-bot: Reminder 1 create procurement ticket before legal review: /po create <vendor> <amount> <budget-code>. default terms net-30. net-45 requires CFO approval.
Dana (Fin): finance decision logic: green if vendor: 1) accepts PO/net-30, 2) bills from US entity (USD) OR provides VAT-complete EU invoice with reverse charge instructions, 3) supplies SOC2 + DPA, 4) credits onboarding or invoices it as a credit in month-1. finance cap for pilot approvals without legal is $100k TCV.
Samir A: asked vendor for: billing entity confirmation, written PO/net-30 acceptance, SOC2 + DPA, 3-day sample export with hashed_request_id, and mapping doc for multi-turn tokenization. vendor replied they can switch to USD invoicing from their US subsidiary but need 5% currency conversion fee if switched. theyre willing to accept PO/net-30 for pilots but asked for onboarding to be invoiced.
Marco (Eng): if they insist on invoicing onboarding, ask for it credited on month-1 invoice. we need the sample export to validate token diffs; will run automated check and flag >2% variance.
Ivy C: negotiation plan: counter-offer: 4-mo pilot, onboarding waived or credited, PO/net-30, 12% pilot discount; if they insist on onboarding invoicing accept but require credit. push back on conversion fee if switching to USD.
LegalBot: loop legal once procurement ticket is created or vendor requests contract exceptions. DPA redlines likely needed if they bill from EU entity.
Dana (Fin): contingent approval: finance will approve PO for up to $96k TCV if vendor accepts PO/net-30 in writing, credits onboarding, and provides SOC2/DPA within 3 business days. otherwise escalate. please attach vendor tax docs to PR.
Samir A: created PR-2026-900 in procurement and linked quote. pinged vendor with counter-offer. target start: 2026-09-01 if green. will post vendor response here. :thumbsup:
